description: Map any Spring / Vue / RuoYi project: modules, features, startup, change history and request flows across services. Deterministic rules first, AI optional.
untrusted: In Restricted Mode Atlas only reads files: cloning repositories listed in atlas.yaml is disabled.
welcome:
No map yet.
[Analyze Workspace](command:atlas.analyze)
No AI key needed: modules, entrypoints, request flows and startup steps come from static rules. [Configure an AI model](command:atlas.configureProvider) later for summaries.

walkthrough.provider.description:
Anthropic, any OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek, Qwen...) or a local Ollama model. You confirm the token estimate before anything is sent.
[Configure AI Model](command:atlas.configureProvider)
walkthrough.test.title: Test the connection
cfg.provider: AI provider. `none` keeps everything local (deterministic map only).
cfg.model: Model id. Empty = provider default (`claude-sonnet-5-5` for Anthropic, `qwen2.5-coder:7b` for Ollama).
cfg.baseUrl: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible APIs (e.g. `https://api.deepseek.com/v1`) or Ollama (`http://localhost:11434`).
cfg.maxInputTokens: Upper limit of input tokens per analysis; Atlas pauses and asks when it would be exceeded.
cfg.outputLanguage: Language of AI summaries. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
cfg.exclude: Extra paths to skip (gitignore syntax), added to `.atlasignore`.
cfg.maxFileSizeKB: Files larger than this are skipped.
cfg.codeLens: Show a request-flow CodeLens above controller methods.
